name: Commander Springvale
summary: Commander Springvale was once a devoted paladin and the head of Baron Silverlaine's armed guard at Shadowfang Keep. Slain alongside his men during the feral worgen slaughter orchestrated by Archmage Arugal, his vengeful spirit remains behind to haunt the castle halls. Even in death, his ghost fiercely guards the keep and seeks vengeance for his fallen master.

sections.title: The Fallen Commander
sections.body: Before the ruin of Shadowfang Keep, Commander Springvale stood as an honorable paladin dedicated to the Holy Light and a sworn defender of Baron Silverlaine. Leading the garrison in Silverpine Forest, he oversaw the keep's security during the fraught days following the fall of Lordaeron to the Scourge.

sections.title: Arugal's Folly
sections.body: When Archmage Arugal summoned the extraplanar worgen to repel the undead Scourge encroaching upon Gilnean soil, the wild beasts quickly slipped from the mage's control. The ravenous pack descended upon the fortress, slaughtering Baron Silverlaine and his entire guard. Springvale perished in the halls he had sworn to protect, his service violently cut short.

sections.title: An Endless Vigil
sections.body: Death offered no release to Springvale. His ghost haunts the keep's council room alongside its spectral soldiers. He still wields paladin powers, including Holy Light and Hammer of Justice, against intruders.

faq.q: Who was Commander Springvale in life?
faq.answer: Commander Springvale was a paladin of the Holy Light who served as the commander of Baron Silverlaine's armed forces. He was tasked with the defense of Shadowfang Keep and remained fiercely loyal to the Baron until his death.

He was killed when Archmage Arugal summoned feral worgen to fight the Scourge. The untamed beasts turned upon the inhabitants of Shadowfang Keep, massacring Baron Silverlaine, Springvale, and the garrison.

faq.q: Why is Commander Springvale haunting Shadowfang Keep?
faq.answer: Twisted in death, his spirit remains bound by his final oaths. Springvale's ghost wanders the halls to defend the ruins and seek vengeance for his fallen lord against all who enter.
Springvale retains paladin abilities in undeath, healing with Holy Light and stunning enemies with Hammer of Justice.
Commander Springvale served Baron Silverlaine, the noble ruler and master of Shadowfang Keep before Arugal's beasts devastated the estate.

faq.q: Where in the keep can he be found?
faq.answer: Commander Springvale's ghost is encountered deep within the keep, haunting the fortified chambers near the castle chapel and council rooms.

angles.text: Springvale is a sobering reminder of how duty and sacred vows can curdle into eternal torment when an honorable knight is bound to a corrupted grave.
Springvale represents the lost soldiers of Lordaeron and Gilneas, loyal defenders who fell not to the Scourge directly, but to the reckless summonings meant to stop them.
For the Forsaken reclaiming Silverpine Forest, laying the commander's shade to rest is another step in purging the remnants of Arugal's tragic failure.
